title: Vendor Bill form cannot generate a bill: it sends no payment term and the backend answers 400
summary: Generating a vendor bill from a received purchase order fails on the screen. The backend now requires a payment term on every bill; the form has a Due Date but no Payment term field and sends no billing.paymentTermId.
steps: Create a purchase order and receive it (item receipt approved).
Open Purchase > Vendor Bills > Generate from the receipt.
Fill the form (a Due Date is offered, there is no Payment term field) and press Generate Bill.
expected: The bill is created, goes through approval and posts to accounting.
actual: The request is refused: 400 "Payment term is required". No bill is created, so a local (non-import) purchase cannot be billed from the screen.
where: Frontend: src/features/purchase/vendor-bill/.../vendor-bill-generation-view.tsx:667; src/erp-api/purchase/vendor-bills/index.ts (BackendGenerateVendorBillFromReceiptPayload has no billing block). Backend rule: VendorBillMapper.toBillingEntity, commit c10dca504 (#116, 2026-11-11).
verify: Add a Payment term select (default from the vendor) to the form and send billing.paymentTermId; remove test.fail() from PUR-01-01 and PUR-05-05 and run e2e/tests/purchase.
status_evidence: Found by the e2e refresh 2026-11-13 on frontend release_beta_1.0.0@05aecf15 against backend deployment/dev@b2597ef11; API calls with billing.paymentTermId succeed, the screen's request does not carry it.

title: LC Master (LC cost) form cannot be saved: it sends no payment term and the backend answers 400
summary: The LC master New form has a Due Date but no Payment term and sends no billing.paymentTermId. The backend requires it, so an LC cost cannot be saved from the screen.
steps: Open Purchase > LC Master > New.
Pick the vendor, add a charge line with an amount, set the dates.
Press Save.
expected: The LC cost is saved as a billable document.
actual: 400 "Payment term is required" (same request with billing.paymentTermId succeeds). Repro without the screen: POST the LC master with a valid charge line and no billing block.
where: Frontend: src/features/purchase/lc-master/components/lc-master-form-view.tsx:941 (Due Date field, no payment term). Backend: LcMasterMapper.toBillingEntity calls paymentTermLookup.require (commit c10dca504).
verify: Add the Payment term select and send billing.paymentTermId; remove test.fail() from PUR-11-05.
status_evidence: Found by the e2e refresh 2026-11-13; API repro with a full request returns 400.

title: A pending vendor payment has no Delete button on its detail page
summary: deleteVendorPaymentAction exists but nothing calls it, so a payment saved by mistake cannot be removed from the screen.
steps: Create a vendor payment (leave it pending).
Open its detail page.
Look for a Delete action.
expected: A pending payment can be deleted from its detail page (as other pending purchase documents can).
actual: There is no Delete button; the server action has no caller.
where: src/erp-api/purchase/vendor-payments (deleteVendorPaymentAction) has no caller in src/features/purchase.
verify: Add the action to the pending-payment detail footer (use AppConfirmAction); remove test.fail() from PUR-06-06.
status_evidence: grep in src finds only the definition of deleteVendorPaymentAction (2026-11-13).

title: Bill payment: after the 'exceeds available prepayment balance' refusal, the next valid Save sometimes does nothing
summary: Intermittent. After the Apply step is refused because the amount is more than the prepayment balance, correcting the amount and pressing Save leaves the button in its loading state and sends no request.
steps: Open a new vendor payment for a bill with a prepayment.
Apply an amount larger than the available prepayment balance; the refusal message appears.
Correct the amount to a valid value and press Save.
actual: Sometimes the Save button stays in 'loading' and no request is sent; a reload is needed. Root cause not found (it failed on the retry, passed once).
verify: Reproduce by hand first (the e2e case is marked test.fail and flaky); then check the submit guard resets after a refused apply.
status_evidence: e2e PUR-06-12 intermittently fails; PUR-06-09 (without the refusal step) passes. Needs a manual reproduction.

title: Sample and Gift Distribution detail shows '#id' instead of the item name for items beyond the first 500
summary: The item names for the distribution screens come from one lookup capped at 500 items. With more items (this test stack has 1115) an item outside that first page shows as '#<id>'.
steps: Have more than 500 items in the system.
Create a sample or gift distribution for an item that is not in the first 500 returned by GET /api/inventory/items?size=500.
Open the distribution detail page.
verify: Look the names up by id (or have the backend return the item name on the distribution line); the two e2e cases then pass without test.fail().
status_evidence: GET /api/inventory/items?size=500 returns 500 of 1115 on the e2e stack; the two cases pass only when the item is inside the first 500.

summary: A user cannot see which credit memo is which in the list; search by memo number still works, so the data exists.
steps: Create a customer credit memo.
Open Sales > Credit Memos (list).
expected: The memo's own number is a column.
actual: Only the return number is shown.
where: Sales credit memo list table columns (src/features/sales/... credit-memo list).
verify: Add the memo number column; SAL-13-13 asserts it.
status_evidence: Seen by the e2e refresh 2026-11-13 while updating SAL-13-13.

title: Credit memo Edit can never be reached: memos are APPROVED the moment they are saved
summary: Product question. The screen offers Edit only on drafts, but the backend approves a credit memo as soon as it is saved (commit c0c704a3), so no memo is ever editable and the backend refuses changes.
steps: Save a credit memo.
Open it and look for Edit.
expected: Either an editable draft state exists, or the Edit control and its tests are removed on purpose.
actual: Status is APPROVED immediately; Edit never appears; a direct change request is refused by the backend.
where: Sales credit memo detail; backend commit c0c704a3.
verify: Decision from the business: (a) memos stay approved on save, Edit code is dead and can go; or (b) restore a draft step.
status_evidence: SAL-12-06 now asserts the current behaviour (no Edit; backend refuses a change).

summary: /transfer-order and /courier-status call notFound() since commit e87ae369 (2026-11-03). The 16 e2e cases for them are skipped and two 404 cases were added.
steps: Open /transfer-order or /courier-status.
expected: Confirmed as intentionally closed (then related tracker items become wontfix) or the screens return.
where: The routes' page.tsx files in src/app/(erp)/inventory-warehouse/.
verify: Answer from the business; then close the related Transfer Order / Courier items as wontfix and delete the skipped cases (or bring the screens back).
status_evidence: Route files return notFound(); commit e87ae369.

title: Dev seeder VendorBillDevSeeder crashes the backend at startup (array index out of bounds)
summary: At startup the dev profile creates a vendor bill for every approved, unbilled item receipt. It picks options[receipt.getId() % terms.length] where terms has 5 entries and options has 4, so any such receipt whose id leaves remainder 4 aborts startup and the container restarts forever.
steps: Run the backend with the dev profile on a database that has an approved item receipt without a bill and id % 5 == 4.
Restart the backend.
actual: ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException: Index 4 out of bounds for length 4 at VendorBillDevSeeder.buildBilling (VendorBillDevSeeder.java:146); the container crash-loops.
verify: Use options[(int) (id % options.length)] or make options 5 long; restart a stack that has such a receipt.
status_evidence: Hit on the e2e stack 2026-11-13 (RestartCount 30); dev-profile seeder only, but it breaks any shared dev or e2e stack after test receipts exist.
